subject: general
question: The mean of marks secured by 3 students in grade A of class XI is 83, that of 4 students of grade B is 76 and that of 5 students of grade C is 85. What will be the mean of marks of the students of three grades of Class XI?
solution:
**Given:**

Mean of marks of 3 students in grade A = 83

Mean of marks of 4 students in grade B = 76

Mean of marks of 5 students in grade C = 85

**Formula used:**

Mean of marks = dfrac{{Sum of marks}}{{Number of students}}
